verses.text: A Prayer of David. Hear, O YHWH, a just cause; attend to my cry; give ear to my prayer without lips of deceit.

segments.text: A Prayer of David. Hear, O YHWH, a just cause; attend to my cry; give ear to my prayer without lips of deceit.

verses.text: From before Your face, let my judgment come forth; may Your eyes see uprightness.

segments.text: From before Your face, let my judgment come forth; may Your eyes see uprightness.

verses.text: You have tested my heart; You have inspected in the night. You have refined me without Your finding, [for] I have purposed [that] my mouth shall not transgress.

segments.text: You have tested my heart; You have inspected in the night. You have refined me without Your finding, [for] I have purposed [that] my mouth shall not transgress.

verses.text: As for the works of men, by the word of Your lips I have kept myself [from] the ways of a violent one.

segments.text: As for the works of men, by the word of Your lips I have kept myself [from] the ways of a violent one.

verses.text: To uphold my steps on Your paths, my footsteps are not shaken.

segments.text: To uphold my steps on Your paths, my footsteps are not shaken.

verses.text: I call on You, for You will answer me, O God! Incline Your ear to me; hear my word.

segments.text: I call on You, for You will answer me, O God! Incline Your ear to me; hear my word.

verses.text: Set apart Your loving devotion, You who save those taking refuge from the assailants—with Your right hand.

segments.text: Set apart Your loving devotion, You who save those taking refuge from the assailants—with Your right hand.

verses.text: May you guard me as the pupil, the daughter of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings,

segments.text: May you guard me as the pupil, the daughter of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings,

verses.text: from wicked ones who would ruin me, my enemies in soul go around against me.

segments.text: from wicked ones who would ruin me, my enemies in soul go around against me.

verses.text: Their fat they have closed up; their mouths they speak with pride.

segments.text: Their fat they have closed up; their mouths they speak with pride.

verses.text: In our steps now they have surrounded us; they have set their eyes to cast [us] to the ground.

segments.text: In our steps now they have surrounded us; they have set their eyes to cast [us] to the ground.

verses.text: His likeness [is] as a lion longing to tear, and like a young lion lurking in hidden places.

segments.text: His likeness [is] as a lion longing to tear, and like a young lion lurking in hidden places.

verses.text: Arise, O YHWH! Go before his face; cast him down, [and] rescue my soul from the wicked by your sword,

segments.text: Arise, O YHWH! Go before his face; cast him down, [and] rescue my soul from the wicked by your sword,

verses.text: from men by Your hand, O YHWH, from men of the world—their portion [is] in this life. And Your treasured ones, You fill their belly; they are satisfied [with] sons, and they leave their remainder to their children.

verses.text: I, in righteousness, will see Your face; in [my] waking, I will be satisfied [with] Your form.
